integrity: The theorem and comparator refer to explicitly defined deterministic local equations; analytic derivations, not finite simulations, establish all asserted infinite-time limits.
scientific_limitations: Local near the degenerate disease-free point for n>1 and gamma>0; does not prove stochastic-network behavior, global attraction or uniform accuracy of the fast-variable approximation.
title: A universal second-order bias in quasi-static adaptive SIS clearance at the rewiring cusp
